concepts.def: Holidays vocabulary: à la mer (seaside), à la montagne (mountains), à l'étranger (abroad), en colonie de vacances (summer camp).
Means of travel: en avion (by plane), en train, en voiture, en bateau, à pied (on foot).
Accommodation: un hôtel, un camping, une auberge de jeunesse (youth hostel), un gîte (holiday cottage).
Near future: 'Je vais aller...' (going to go). Simple future: 'J'irai...' (I will go). Used to talk about holiday plans.
Il fait beau (nice), il fait chaud (hot), il pleut (raining), il neige (snowing). Often used to describe holidays.
Used for descriptions in the past: 'Il faisait beau' (It was nice). Endings: -ais, -ais, -ait, -ions, -iez, -aient.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Theme 6: Travel and Tourism — a core area of GCSE French.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Theme 6: Travel and Tourism brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Theme 6: Travel and Tourism.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which sentence means 'I am going to go to Spain'?
options: Je vais aller en Espagne.
Je suis allé en Espagne.
J'allais en Espagne.
Je vais en Espagne demain hier.

mcqs.q: Which preposition is correct: 'Je voyage ___ avion'?
options: en
à
par
de

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I am going to Spain' in French?
options: Je vais à Espagne.
Je vais à mon ami.
Je vais en Espagne.
Je viens en Espagne.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I am going to visit Paris' (near future) in French?
options: Je vais visite Paris.
Je vais à Espagne.
Je vais visiter Paris.
Je vais à visiter Paris.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I'm going to my friend's house' in French?
options: Je vais à la maison de mon ami.
Je vais chez mon ami.
Je vais à mon ami.
Je vais à Espagne.
